title: Luxe | 9 Beds, Pool, Hot Tub, Sleeps 12+
description:
Singing Saddles
Karaoke Setup | Private Hot Tub | City Rooftop Views | 

Singing Saddles is a brand-new luxe 4-bedroom, 4.5-bathroom Nashville getaway that can accommodate up to 18 guests. Experience the best of Nashville alongside features like a custom karaoke setup, private rooftop with hot tub, outdoor kitchen, and a massive dining table for 10. Enjoy resort-style perks like a pool, fire pit, and happy hour events—all just 10 minutes from Broadway. Big group? Big fun.

The space
Your Nashville Experience ~ Welcome to Music City! 
The Horizon community offers a prime downtown Nashville location. On site - resort-style pool with cabanas and loungers, happy hour and weekly events (for free!), and fire pits for cool Nashville evenings. When you're ready to explore, you're never more than 15 mins away from all Nashville has to offer. 
- Five Star Saturdays ~ Happy Hour with free drinks at Horizon Cabana from 11am-3pm every Saturday!       
- 10-minutes to Downtown Nashville and Broadway
- Less than 15 minutes to Music Row, 12 South, or The Gulch 
- Less than 10 mins from Topgolf, First Horizon Park, and Nissan Stadium

Step Inside and Enjoy ~ 
➡️Private Rooftop: A true highlight! Features a hot tub, fire pits, outdoor kitchen, and smart TV—set under twinkle lights with amazing Music City views.
➡️Converted Garage Hangout: Your own karaoke-ready space; complete with neon signs, cowboy hats, a getting-ready vanity, plus a cozy sectional and TV. 
➡️Four Bedrooms, Four Ensuites: Each bedroom offers its own private bathroom for added comfort and convenience.
➡️Thoughtful Luxury Touches: Stylish décor throughout, plus complimentary snacks and coffee to enjoy during your stay.
➡️Kitchen & Dining: Fully equipped for anything from late-night pizza to full meals, with a spacious island that seats six and makes dinners easy. 
➡️Living Area: Designed for relaxing, featuring a large sectional, electric fireplace, and a big-screen smart TV.
➡️Coffee & Tea Station: Tucked just off the kitchen, with a Nespresso machine, frother, French press, grinder, and kettle—everything you need to make your perfect cup.

For Rest ~ 
- First Floor: Primary King Bedroom with ensuite
- Second Floor: 2 Queen Bedroom with ensuite
- Third Floor: 2 Double over Double bunk beds with ensuite
- Third Floor: 2 Queen Bedroom with ensuite

The Essentials. All Included in your stay ~
- Premium full-size bath products in every bathroom/kitchen. We provide body wash, shampoo, conditioner, lotion, and hand soap.
- We provide a starter kit of everything you’ll need to kick off your stay: paper towels, toilet paper, dish soap, laundry pods, and more.
- Coffee is on us! Complimentary grounds from Nashville’s favorite, The Well.
- Free Parking On-site. (2 dedicated spaces available)
- High-speed Wi-Fi
- Stacked Washer and Dryer

Guest access
It's all yours! Guests will have 100% access to the entire home during their stay!
For your convenience, we provide you with self check-in instructions so that you can let yourself in upon arrival.

This home is proudly managed by Kalos Dwellings. 
Please don't hesitate to reach out if you have any questions, we're here to help.

Other things to note
✏️Other Things to Note
- Parking: There are 2 spaces available.
- Minimum age to rent the home is 25. 
- Pets: Apologies, no furry friends are allowed at the home. We appreciate your understanding on this.
- Vacation disruptions can be a bummer. While it doesn’t happen often, you may experience issues with Wi-Fi. We are not responsible for any disruptions to the Wi-Fi service or any construction that may affect your experience. Please note that such occurrences are beyond our control, and we appreciate your understanding and patience in these matters.
